shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la node_modules/next/dist/docs && rg -n \"Link|navigation|routing|href\" node_modules/next/dist/docs -g \"*.md\" | head -n 40 && sed -n '1,200p' app/Navigation.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files app && sed -n '1,200p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' app/about/page.tsx 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,200p' app/contact/page.tsx 2>/dev/null || true && rg -n \"next/link|href=|Navigation|More Pages\" app"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"title: <Link>|import Link from 'next/link'\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app node_modules/next/dist/docs/02-pages | head -n 20 && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | rg -i \"link\" | head -n 20"
/bin/bash -lc 'git checkout -- tsconfig.json && git clean -fd -- .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff -- app/Navigation.tsx'
